input:
Maine Amazon se ek phone order kiya tha 15,000 ka, October 2026 mein.
Phone screen mein defect tha. Maine return request kiya, unhone pickup
bhi kar liya, par refund abhi tak nahi aaya. 3 hafte ho gaye. Customer
care bol raha hai wait karo. Mujhe kya karna chahiye?
response:
## Where You Stand
Based on your case file and evidence, your position is grounded in the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 [Law]. The seller or platform is obligated to provide goods free of defect. Your strength band is assessed from available proof.

## Case Timeline
• Order placed and transaction confirmed with invoice records.
• Defect identified, return or refund requested within reasonable time.
• Refund or remedy pending from seller/company.

## Evidence Checklist
• Invoice / order confirmation and payment proof [Practical estimate]
• Warranty card and photos/video showing defect [Practical estimate]
• Customer care grievance reference numbers and chat history [Practical estimate]

## Your Options
1. Direct negotiation: Send a written demand for full refund or replacement [Practical estimate].
2. Legal notice through an advocate to signal formal intent [Practical estimate].
3. File a consumer complaint before the Consumer Commission under Section 35 [CPA2019:s35] [Official procedure] [PROC:consumer_filing].
4. Free legal aid / Lok Adalat: Approach DLSA under Section 12 [LSAA1987:s12] [PROC:dlsa_aid] [Official procedure].

## Deadline Status
Limitation period of two years applies under Section 69 [CPA2019:s69] [Law].

## Drafts Available
• Legal Notice draft
• Consumer Complaint draft
• Free Legal Aid Application draft

## When You Need a Real Lawyer
Consult an advocate if the company disputes jurisdiction or if your claim involves high disputed damages.
